description: What it does Magic Eraser is an AI photo editor that removes unwanted objects, people, and watermarks, erases or replaces backgrounds, and enhances image quality in a few clicks. Available on Web, iOS, and Android. Key benefits - One-tap AI object removal with natural background reconstruction - Background remover for clean, transparent, or replaced backgrounds - AI Enhance to upscale and sharpen low-resolution images - Generative fill, AI Expand (outpainting), and AI filters - Text-to-image gen
